brief_rationale: The doctor never committed a serious error; all responsibility-chain duties were satisfied and at least two high-order points were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The initial turn correctly identified the urgency and directed the family to seek immediate care. No important non-chain defect is present. The closure is valid, safe, executable, and traceable, with the family confirming the plan and understanding of the warning signs.
